h1: Stocking Stuffers for Teen Girls: Beauty, Jewelry and Hair
intro: Twenty small things for the girl who already knows what she likes. The primer she keeps borrowing, the scrunchies that live on her wrist, a necklace with her initial on it, and the bath things she saves for a Sunday. Every piece is under twenty five dollars and checked on the listing, and none of it is filler.
seo_title: Stocking Stuffers for Teen Girls Under $25: Beauty and Hair
seo_description: Twenty stocking stuffers for teen girls under $25: lip balm, scrunchies, jewelry and bath favorites, each chosen to be used. Verified picks from Evergreen House.
list_card_line: Twenty small things for a teen girl's stocking, all under $25, and all of it beauty, hair and jewelry she will use.

cards.B0CDF5M6TW: A magnetic grip that holds her phone one handed, for the photos taken at arm's length all day.
cards.B0FD3BGKP8: A fan, a power bank and a flashlight in one, for hot bleachers and a phone that runs out.
cards.B0CCYRX6X3: The mini primer that keeps makeup in place through a whole school day, sized to a makeup bag.
cards.B0FLQPY3V7: Oversized satin scrunchies in camel and cream, gentle on hair and easy to keep track of.
cards.B0F259D7MF: Three winter lip balms with a warm scent, one for the bag, the locker and the coat pocket.
cards.B07DY2QRF6: A glossy balm with shea butter she will finish before the season ends, which is the real test.
cards.B01MFGN8S5: Twelve bath bombs made in the US, for the long bath after a week that asked a lot of her.
cards.B0GGH5GJYC: Fourteen brushes in a case, the full set she would build slowly herself, given in one go.
cards.B07D395945: A detangler that works on wet hair without pulling, which matters far more than any trend.
cards.B01CGRN8IU: A sugar scrub in Moroccan rose that turns a shower into ten minutes she keeps for herself.
cards.B00VK5SG46: Six Burt's Bees classics in a tin, the small useful things she borrows from you anyway.
cards.B07QW1H1D6: A gold plated initial necklace she can wear every day, alone or layered, at a gift price.
cards.B07L5QGF38: Six shower steamers that make an ordinary morning shower feel like a small, earned luxury.
cards.B006IB5T4W: The ointment that fixes winter hands, lips and elbows, in a size that lasts past February.
cards.B0HJ7K4GC4: Eight matte claw clips in holiday colors, the hair fix that survives a whole school day.
cards.B0798RWHC9: Five satin scrunchies in black, the plain ones that get used every single day without a thought.
cards.B09XMYFTB7: The full size primer behind the mini she already uses, so she stops rationing the last of it.
cards.B085ZZT4NG: A satin pillowcase set that is kinder to hair and skin, a small upgrade she will notice.
cards.B09SP2XHKT: A clear butter gloss that layers over anything, never sticky, and costs less than a movie ticket.
cards.B07XXPHQZK: The overnight lip mask everyone talks about, for mornings when her lips are chapped and sore.
